headline: Chirpi Evolution
title: Aniimo Chirpi Evolution | Cornet Tromber or Tubster | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Chirpi evolves at level eighteen, and it has three branches. Cornet needs nothing extra. Tromber needs the Magic Horn talent and an HP Potential of six or higher. Tubster needs you to defeat the Alpha Tubster and have a BREAK Potential of six or higher. Each Chirpi can only take one branch. You can catch Chirpi in Nimbus Fields. Which branch will you pick? Comment below!
description: Chirpi evolves at level 18 into Cornet, Tromber or Tubster in Aniimo, with extra requirements for Tromber and Tubster.
